title: A Bus Driver's Interview
text:
Carlos is a bus driver. Yesterday a radio station interviewed him about his job. The presenter asked him what time he starts work. Carlos said that he starts at five in the morning.

The presenter also asked about his favorite route. Carlos likes the road by the river because the view is beautiful. He hopes to keep driving that route for many years.

questions.text: What does Carlos like about the road by the river?
How does Carlos probably feel about his job?
options: He does not like the city

questions.text: Why did the radio station most likely interview Carlos?
options: He has an interesting job to talk about

vocabulary.definition: asked a person questions for a radio, TV, or newspaper report
the way you travel from one place to another
what you can see from a particular place
the work that a person does to earn money

paragraph_translations: Carlos es conductor de autobús. Ayer una emisora de radio lo entrevistó sobre su trabajo. El presentador le preguntó a qué hora empieza a trabajar. Carlos dijo que empieza a las cinco de la mañana.
El presentador también preguntó por su ruta favorita. A Carlos le gusta la carretera junto al río porque la vista es muy bonita. Espera seguir conduciendo esa ruta durante muchos años.
